Excel 转 HTML——每个工作表一张表，本地生成Excel to HTML offline — one table per sheet

需要把表格贴进内网、邮件或静态站点时，Excel 的公式与样式反而成了负担。这条路径用 SheetJS 读工作簿（`cellDates` 标记日期、统一 `dateNF` 决定渲染格式），把每个工作表转成一张 HTML 表：多张表时每张前加 `<h2>工作表名</h2>`，只保留表格片段，再整体过一遍 DOMPurify，最后包成带字符集与标题的完整文档。产物是单个 .html，所有工作表都在里面，没有脚本、没有外部依赖。When a table has to go into an intranet page, an email or a static site, Excel’s formulas and styling become baggage. This route reads the workbook with SheetJS (`cellDates` flags dates and one `dateNF` decides how they render), turns each sheet into an HTML table, puts an `<h2>` with the sheet name in front of each when there is more than one, keeps only table fragments, sanitizes the whole thing with DOMPurify and wraps it into a full document with a charset and title. The result is one .html with every sheet inside, no scripts and no external dependencies.

共 1 步，由扩展的路径搜索自动选出，中间产物不落盘。1 step, chosen by the extension's own path search; intermediate results never touch the disk.

会保留什么What carries over

  • 每个工作表都导出，多表时用 `<h2>` 标出表名，不会只给你第一张Every sheet is exported, with an `<h2>` naming each one when there are several — never just the first
  • 单元格值按显示文本落地：日期由统一格式渲染成文本，不做本地化猜测Cell values land as displayed text: dates are rendered through one fixed format rather than a locale guess
  • 公式单元格取工作簿里缓存的计算结果，HTML 里不写公式本身Formula cells carry the cached result stored in the workbook; the formula itself is not written into the HTML
  • 产物是一个独立完整的 .html（声明字符集与标题），双击即可离线打开The output is one complete .html with a charset and title that opens offline on a double-click
  • 一批最多 200 个文件、单个 100 MBUp to 200 files per batch at 100 MB each

如实说明的限制What it does not do

  • 不带 Excel 的视觉样式：字体、填充色、边框、行高列宽、条件格式与冻结窗格都不会出现Excel’s visual styling does not come along: fonts, fills, borders, row heights and column widths, conditional formatting and frozen panes are absent
  • 工作簿里的图片、图表与批注不进入 HTML——表格序列化只处理单元格Images, charts and comments inside the workbook do not enter the HTML — the table serializer handles cells
  • 多工作表一定合并进同一个 HTML；要“一表一文件”请走 Excel → CSV（多表会打成 ZIP）Multiple sheets always share one HTML; for one file per sheet, use Excel → CSV, which packs them into a ZIP
  • 不给 Excel 回读：HTML 是单向出口，要回到表格请用 CSV → ExcelExcel cannot read it back: HTML is a one-way exit, so return to a spreadsheet through CSV → Excel

实操提示Working with it

  • 适合把报表、名单与导出数据发布成可离线打开的静态页Good for publishing a report, a roster or an export as a static page that opens offline
  • 要保留单元格里的原始值给下游程序，CSV 或 JSON 更合适；这条路径面向“给人看”For raw cell values feeding another program, CSV or JSON fits better; this route is aimed at people reading
  • 同一份 .xlsx 还能转 PDF（整页渲染、无文字层）或 CSVThe same .xlsx can go to PDF (whole-page rendering, no text layer) or CSV

常见问题Questions people actually ask

日期为什么变成了文本？Why did dates become text?

Excel 的日期本质是一个带格式的数字。这条路径在解析时把日期单元格标记出来，再按统一格式渲染成文本，避免出现 45296 这样的序列号；代价是失去了 Excel 里的区域化显示。An Excel date is a number with a format. This route flags date cells while parsing and renders them through one fixed format, so a serial like 45296 does not leak through; the cost is Excel’s locale-specific display.

多个工作表会分开下载吗？Are multiple sheets downloaded separately?

不会。它们按顺序进入同一个 HTML，每张前面有 `<h2>` 表名；想一表一个文件，请用 Excel → CSV，那条会把多表打包成 ZIP。No. They enter one HTML in order, each preceded by an `<h2>` with its name; for one file per sheet, use Excel → CSV, which packs them into a ZIP.

样式和图表去哪了？Where did the styling and charts go?

都没有进入产物。表格序列化只输出单元格文本与表格结构，Excel 的字体、颜色、条件格式、图片与图表不在其中；这是“变成网页表格”而不是“把 Excel 截图成网页”。Neither made it into the result. The table serializer writes cell text and table structure only; Excel’s fonts, colours, conditional formatting, images and charts are not part of it. This turns the workbook into a web table, not into a screenshot of Excel.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
